title: Total restricted Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $J$ be a subset of its coordinate set. For each subset of $J$, form its restricted Fourier weight by summing the squared Fourier coefficients over all frequencies obtained by adjoining a subset of the coordinates outside $J$. The sum of these restricted Fourier weights over all subsets of $J$ equals the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all subsets of the full coordinate set.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
